bigfoot_story.last_result: You hear the wise bigfoot’s voice again as he guides you up the sky piercing staircase. Time and meaning slip away, you stop thinking and simply melt up the stairs. After what feels like centuries, you glance up and see a bigfoot at a golden gate. It takes your hand and leads you into bigfoot paradise. You live and die a thousand times, explore distant galaxies, become the dust in all essence. Then you suddenly awake back home, with $20,000 in your pocket and a new background customization option.

alien_story.last_result: You use your psychic powers to shoot lightning bolts that open Mr Goobles’ jail cell. He thanks you in Alienese and the two of you steal jetpacks and flee the military base. In the distance, you see the old fellow with medals giving chase, but he falls into quicksand and is swallowed whole by the earth. The three original agents salute you, for which later they were sentenced to 320 years in jail. Twenty years after the incident, you and Goobles sit on the beach drinking chocolate milk out of coconuts. Mr. Goobles’ leans over, hands you $20,000, and says ‘you’ve done a lot for green people, so here’s some of them on paper.’
